title: Vectors: TOFU pin/reject scenarios
close_reason: Satisfied by test/vectors/gcp3_trust_models.json: TOFU pin/reject coverage via tofu_valid_first_contact (expected pin_and_accept), tofu_derivation_mismatch_attack and tofu_key_mismatch_detection (expected reject_derivation_mismatch), plus key_rotation_invalid_signature (reject_invalid_signature) and tampered open-federation messages — normal pin and multiple reject scenarios with pinned_pubkey/pinned_iid fixtures. Machine-consumed by python/tests/crypto/test_trust.py which loads the file (GCP3_VECTORS) and drives its rotation vectors through the production oracle (verify_pubkey_derivation, schnorr_verify, TrustStore.verify_or_pin TOFU pinning, rotate_key_semantics_for_test expecting TrustError on rejects); matching TOFU behavior is exercised by unit tests auto_pin_on_first_contact / verify_pinned_peer / reject_key_mismatch / reject_derivation_mismatch. Note: rust trust.rs files reference this file but are orphaned modules not wired into any crate, so Python is the live consumer. Ran: cd python && uv run --extra dev pytest tests/crypto/test_trust.py -q => 58 passed.
